content: {"phoneNote":"The header stacks name, phone and directions into three loose rows that eat a fifth of the first screen before the photo appears, and the second photo (mountain landscape) has nothing to do with foot care.","desktopNote":"Hero is balanced and calm, but the 'Za stopala' section pairs a short text block with a tall landscape photo, leaving a large dead band under the copy, and the services list spreads name/description/price too far apart across 1280px.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":3,"spacing":3,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":3,"spacing":3,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":3},"fixes":["Replace the mountain landscape in 'Za stopala, ki potrebujejo več pozornosti' with a photo of the studio, tools or a treatment; it currently reads as a tourist-farm image.","Compact the phone header into one row (name left, phone icon + pin icon right) so the hero photo and headline start higher on the first screen.","Tighten the desktop 'Za stopala' section: cap photo height to the text column or add a short list of conditions treated, and narrow the services table so description sits closer to the name."],"blockers":[]}
